properties.displayName: JA4proxy - Dial Change Outside Maintenance Window
properties.description: Detects when the JA4proxy blocking dial is changed outside the defined maintenance window (09:00-11:00 UTC Monday-Friday). An unexpected dial decrease could indicate an attacker or insider reducing the proxy's blocking aggression. Correlates with MITRE ATT&CK T1562 (Impair Defenses).
properties.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where RawData has 'config_change'
| extend EventAction = tostring(parse_json(RawData)["event.action"])
| where EventAction == 'config_change'
| extend
    NewDial = toint(parse_json(RawData)["ja4proxy.dial_setting"]),
    OldDial = toint(parse_json(RawData)["ja4proxy.dial_setting_previous"]),
    ChangedBy = tostring(parse_json(RawData)["ja4proxy.changed_by"]),
    HostName = tostring(parse_json(RawData)["host.name"])
| extend
    HourUTC = hourofday(TimeGenerated),
    DayUTC = dayofweek(TimeGenerated),
    IsWeekday = dayofweek(TimeGenerated) between (1d .. 5d),
    IsMaintenanceHour = hourofday(TimeGenerated) between (9 .. 10)
| extend IsMaintenanceWindow = IsWeekday and IsMaintenanceHour
| where not(IsMaintenanceWindow)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    HostName,
    OldDial,
    NewDial,
    DialDelta = NewDial - OldDial,
    ChangedBy,
    IsWeekday,
    HourUTC

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: JA4proxy dial changed from {{OldDial}} to {{NewDial}} on {{HostName}} outside the maintenance window. Changed by: {{ChangedBy}}.
